description: TU Delft provides combined Delfland coastal morphology surveys after Sand Motor construction from 2011 to 2016. Marine and aeolian cross-shore profiles span an alongshore extent of 17 kilometres. Zandmotor, NeMo, Vlugtenburg and JarKus observations performed near each other in time are jointly interpolated to transects. Coverage: 2011/2016. Access: public native metadata describes the identified resource. Licence: 4TU General Terms of Use. Current file access and cost are unknown. Provider-specific reuse conditions have not been read where general terms apply. Caveats: The native description uses bi-monthly wording without settling its exact meaning. Raw versus interpolated forms and source-release relationships remain distinct. Detailed interpolation assumptions and measurement errors are unstated. Related resources are separately identified in the native collection. The native Sand Motor collection identifies a coastal-protection nourishment and monitoring programme. Simulation use concerns its coastal geometry and sediment or hydrodynamic calibration.
